metadata.description: Plugins that make your work with Claude Code robust: each change is shaped before it is built and reviewed before it lands, it leaves a record the next session can build on, and nothing you notice along the way gets lost. Start with ymer, the core practice; domain plugins can build on it for particular kinds of work. You bring a Ymer Node running on your machine and a folder for your work, and connecting a ymer.ax account adds a shared roadmap. Install ymer, then run /ymer:setup, which creates what is missing and reports what it found.
